== Notes ==
* When Mantra of Resolve successfully prevents an interrupt, it removes the set amount of energy; however, if the [[character]] does not have enough energy for removal, Mantra of Resolve will still prevent one interruption, then it will finally end. This also applies to [[Distortion]].
* Does not work against interrupts that recharge the affected spell, e.g. it does not prevent [[Power Block]].
